text.zh: 开服新手最常问用哪个服务端核心、哪个 JDK，作者认为这些都不是重点。文章先把服务端分成原版、纯插件、纯模组、混合四类，引 Folia 官方的话说明它不是 Paper 的替代品，而且要 16 核以上才发挥得出来；再实测 OpenJDK 和 Azul Zulu，跑图用时和 GC 停顿都相差无几。结论是把精力放在服务器的内容、平衡和玩家社群上。
text.en: New Minecraft server owners keep asking which server software and which JDK to use; the author argues it barely matters. The post sorts servers into vanilla, plugin, mod and hybrid, quotes Folia's own site that it is no drop-in replacement for Paper and wants 16 or more cores, and benchmarks OpenJDK against Azul Zulu: chunk generation time and GC pauses come out almost the same. The advice is to spend the effort on content, balance and the community instead.
